# Saturn 3D Precision Manufacturing

> Saturn 3D is an industrial additive manufacturing laboratory and custom 3D printing service based in Sector B, Govindpura Industrial Area, Bhopal, Madhya Pradesh 462023, India. Specializing in rapid prototyping, engineering hardware, and low-volume batch production with tolerances down to ±0.04mm. Centrally located in Bhopal for express 24-48h air delivery across all Indian states.

## Geographic & Local Presence (Bhopal, Madhya Pradesh, India)
- **Facility Address**: Sector B, Govindpura Industrial Area, Bhopal, MP 462023, India
- **Local Service**: Same-day pickups, technical consultations for MANIT Bhopal, IISER Bhopal, AIIMS, Mandideep, and Pithampur industrial corridors.
- **National Delivery**: 24-hour express air courier to Mumbai, Delhi-NCR, Bengaluru, Pune, Hyderabad, and Indore; 48-hour delivery across tier-2 and tier-3 Indian cities.
- **Contact & WhatsApp**: +91 79998 24632 | Email: hello@saturn3d.in | engineering@saturn3d.in

## Core Services & Capabilities
- **Instant CAD Quoting Lab** (https://saturn3d.in/custom-lab): Real-time analysis of .STEP, .STP, .STL, .OBJ, and .3MF files with instant volume pricing, zero minimum order quantity (MOQ), and automated infill optimization.
- **Industrial FDM Printing**: High-rigidity enclosures, drone airframes, and functional jigs in Carbon-X PA12, ABS-ESD, and PETG.
- **12K SLA Photopolymer Resin**: Ultra-smooth surface finish (25 micron layer height) for micro-fluidics, jewelry masters, and anatomical scale models.
- **Small Batch & Bridge Manufacturing**: 1 to 5,000+ units with volume discounts up to 35%.

## How to Order Custom 3D Prints in India
1. Visit https://saturn3d.in/custom-lab
2. Upload CAD model (.STEP, .STL, .OBJ)
3. Select material (PLA Pro, PETG, ABS-ESD, Carbon-X PA12, or SLA Resin)
4. Confirm automated quote and place order
5. Dispatched within 24-48 hours via express air shipping across India
